text:
sophia.sales: Heads-up team  CloudVertex co-launch assets uploaded for review: logos (SVG/PNG), one-pager solution brief draft, two customer case drafts (anonymized), marketplace tile comps, and an architecture diagram for the SI integration flow. Goal: final-ready by EoD next Friday.

elaine.partnerships: Files are live in the shared drive: https://drive.redwood.example/CloudVertex-co-launch-2026. Please work from the `master` folder only.

jordan.design: Scanned the hero assets. CloudVertex policy: their mark must remain on a solid background (no image overlays) and we cant apply drop shadows. Also they supplied a locked color swatch (Pantone + hex).

carlos.cloudvertex: confirmed here  see attached brand pdf in the drive. We also request the SI diagram not show internal customer names or network addresses.

mike.marketing: Quick ask: marketplace tile copy should be ~100-140 chars. I'll draft a product-forward one and a more technical one for the marketplace details page. Which one do we submit to CloudVertex for review?

sophia.sales: Submit both options so partner can pick. Note: partner asked to prioritize enterprise security language (VPC, private deployments) in marketplace copy.

aisha.translations: FYI I'll need at least 48h lead time if CloudVertex requests FR/DE localization for the marketplace tile and brief. Please flag early.

jordan.design: Technical notes: exporting marketplace PNGs at 1200x600 (and 2400x1200 @2x) and PDF master at A4. I found two logo variants `cv-mark-primary.svg` and `cv-mark-reversed.svg`. The reversed is only for dark backgrounds and requires written permission.

priya.legal: Legal checklist: (1) confirm trademark usage doc signed by partner contact; (2) any customer quotes require partner sign-off (they requested a 72h review window); (3) we must avoid implying joint certification with cloud vendors unless partners approve copy. I'll prepare the approval email and the JIRA ticket.

legal-bot: automated reminder: create ticket `partner-asset-approval-2491234567` when assets set to "review-ready".

elaine.partnerships: Two partner constraints to call out: no other vendor logos in the solution brief (replace with generic icons), and the co-branded badge must use the supplied spacing — they attached a badge spec.

mike.marketing: Copy draft uploaded: `/copy/CloudVertex-marketplace-short.md`. Product tone with security emphasis. Adding an alt blurb for the marketplace details page with technical bullet points.

sophia.sales: Action list: Jordan  finalize PDF master + tiles by tomorrow EOD. Mike  finalize short + technical blurb. Priya  send approval email and create legal ticket. Elaine  confirm CloudVertex reviewer contact and escalate translations if requested. Aisha  stand by for localization. I'll coordinate partner send.

jordan.design: Will also attach a flattened PNG for quick partner preview. Avoiding drop shadows per brand.

carlos.cloudvertex: Also, small ask  for the SI diagram, can you remove internal hostnames and swap in placeholder `customer-acme`? We'll approve faster if PII is removed.

priya.legal: Draft approval email (copy paste): "Hi Carlos and team, attaching co-branded assets for review. Please confirm (1) logo usage, (2) customer quote approvals (if any), (3) final copy for marketplace tile. We request review within 72 hours. If we do not hear back we will follow up on day 4." Thoughts?

sophia.sales: Looks fine. Add a line about the co-brand badge needing explicit sign-off.

legal-bot: task created: `partner-asset-approval-2491234567` assigned to priya.legal, due 2491310400.

aisha.translations: Flagged the drive folder for potential localization. Please add source copy file with context notes to avoid mistranslation of product terms.

mike.marketing: Small content decision: do we include the metric "reduced inference cost by 18%" in the short blurb, or reserve metrics for the case study?

carlos.cloudvertex: We're OK with the 18% figure if you include the measurement period (Q4) and the attribution line. We'll need time to confirm the number internally.

sophia.sales: OK plan: keep marketplace blurb metric-free, add metric + attribution in case study draft. Partner sign-off still required.

jordan.design: Upload complete: `CloudVertex_co-launch_assets_v2.zip` (includes PNGs, PDF master, and SI diagram redacted). Link in drive. :white_check_mark:

elaine.partnerships: Scheduling partner send for Tue 10:00am PT to start the 72-hour review window. Any objections?

mike.marketing: No objections. I'll freeze copy before send.

priya.legal: I'll queue the approval ticket once you mark assets as review-ready.

sophia.sales: Thanks everyone  please post when tasks are complete and we'll close out this thread.

mike.marketing: Will post final copy tomorrow AM. :rocket:
